يميز هذا المؤشر  بين ثلاث فئات من العمالة، هي: العاملون بأجر، والعاملون لحسابهم الخاص، والعاملون لمكسب عائلي.

translations.word: Employment by Status (as a Percentage of Total Employment)|This indicator distinguishes three categories of employment: employees, self-employed, and contributing family workers. It provides information on the distribution of the labor force by status in employment. The percentage of employed persons in the country can be shown according to whether they are wage employees or self-employed. According to the International Classification of Status in Employment (ICSE), classifying individuals by employment status provides a statistical basis for describing workers’ behavior and working conditions, and for determining the individual’s social and economic group. This indicator also makes it possible to identify the extent of wage employment, which reflects the availability of real job opportunities, as well as to analyze the composition of the labor force and the type of economy in the country. The indicator can be calculated according to basic available characteristics such as gender, nationality, educational level, and economic activity.
